input: Find an adaptive sports league for my disabled cousin

gold.taskTitle: Find an adaptive sports league for disabled cousin
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a suitable adaptive sports league that matches the cousin's disability, interests, age, and location.

questions.title: What city or region does your cousin live in?
questions.description: Location is essential to finding leagues that are geographically accessible.

questions.title: What type of disability does your cousin have?
questions.description: The nature of the disability determines which adaptive sports and leagues are appropriate.

questions.title: What sport or activity is your cousin interested in?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred sport narrows the search to relevant leagues.

questions.title: How old is your cousin?
questions.description: Age determines whether to look for youth, adult, or senior adaptive leagues.

questions.title: Is your cousin looking for competitive or recreational play?
questions.description: This distinguishes between casual participation and organized competitive leagues.

questions.title: Does your cousin need in-person leagues only, or is virtual acceptable?
questions.description: Some adaptive sports programs offer hybrid or virtual formats depending on the activity.

questions.title: Is there a budget limit for registration or equipment fees?
questions.description: Cost constraints help filter out leagues that may be financially inaccessible.
